)

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the style of the visualization
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot to visualize the relationship between Sleep Duration and Daily Steps, colored by BMI Category
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
scatter_plot = sns.scatterplot(
    data=data,
    x='Sleep Duration',
    y='Daily Steps',
    hue='BMI Category',
    style='Gender',
    palette='deep',
    s=100
)

# Add labels and title
scatter_plot.set_title('Relationship between Sleep Duration and Daily Steps by BMI Category', fontsize=14)
scatter_plot.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
scatter_plot.set_ylabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=12)

# Place the legend outside the plot
plt.legend(title='BMI Category', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
